svg.text: Microservices Database-per-Service Architecture • Relational Schemas & Crow's Foot Cardinality • Black Canvas & White Marker Theme

g.text: Decoupled from Passwords for Security Isolation
ER DIAGRAM NOTATION LEGEND & MICROSERVICES RELATIONAL INTEGRITY ARCHITECTURE
AeroBook Engineering Standard • ISO/IEC 9075 Relational Specification
One or Many (1..* Required At Least 1)
Primary Key: Unique identifier, indexed B-Tree, clustered index.
Physical Foreign Key: Intra-DB constraint, referential integrity.
Logical Foreign Key: Inter-microservice reference across databases.
Unique Constraint: No duplicate entries permitted (email, pnr, etc.).
Solid White Line: Intra-DB physical relationship enforced by MySQL InnoDB.
Dashed Cyan Line: Logical cross-service link maintained at API layer via Feign.
• No distributed 2-Phase-Commit (2PC) transactions across service schemas.
• Relational schemas normalized to 3NF; zero unmanaged data anomalies.
• Each database independently scalable, backup-capable, and failover-isolated.
